title: A mixed Q3 for Beiersdorf as La Prairie accelerates and Nivea struggles
summary: Beiersdorf's third-quarter 2026 results highlighted contrasting performances across its skincare portfolio, with double-digit growth in Derma and a strong rebound at La Prairie offset by continued pressure on Nivea. The group's net sales reached EUR 2.36 billion, down 1.3% organically in the July-September period, compared with a 2.3% decline in the second quarter.
